question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution are related to citizenship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Articles 5 to 11.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Citizenship in India is governed by **Articles 5 – 11 (Part II) **of the Constitution.**​​**
 
• **Article 5** of the Constitution talks about** India's citizenship** at its inception.
 
• In order to **fully enjoy any State** in which a person enjoys** civil and political rights,** one must be a **citizen of that State.**
 
• The** Indian Parliament** was given the authority to **enact laws governing citizenship rights** under **Article 11**.
 
• This clause led to the** Indian Parliament** passing the **Citizenship Act 1955.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Articles 25 to 28:**

 
 
• **Religious organizations** as well as **people in India **are guaranteed the **right to freedom of religion** under the country's constitution.
 
• Articles 25 to 28 contain a **declaration **of this.
 
 
 
• **Articles 12 to 35:**
 
 
• Everyone has the right to petition the **Supreme Court and the High Courts **for the enforcement of their** fundamental rights, r**egardless of **race, religion, caste, or sex.**
 
• Fundamental Rights (FR) are divided into **six categories** and are covered under Articles 12-35.
 
 
 
• **Article 14 to 18:**
 
 
• It is defined **equality of our country's citizens **and race, caste, sex, religion, place of birth.
